name: Agora

Agora operates as a digital dollar and an asset platform for businesses, fintechs, and trading firms. It powers digital dollar infrastructure through its institutional-grade stablecoin, AUSD, which remains fully collateralized by cash, U.S. Treasuries, repos, and stablecoins. The platform enables businesses to mint and manage digital dollars, integrating with DeFi and traditional finance ecosystems. This vision is becoming a reality with the advent of the “self-writing internet,” a paradigm where AI-driven tools empower anyone to develop, own, and update fully on-chain web apps through natural language interactions.
